# Calibration on real data (generated by calibrate_crypto.py)

Binance spot one-minute bars from the public archive (data.binance.vision); every file's SHA-256 checksum was verified. Fit period 2025-11 to 2026-06, evaluation period 2026-07 to 2026-10. R² is out of sample (evaluation period) and relative to forecasting zero; intervals are 95% block-bootstrap intervals over days. Runtime 311 s.

| Market | Minutes | Minutes missing in the archive | Fit minutes | Evaluation minutes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| BTCUSDT | 525,600 | 0 | 348,450 | 177,120 |
| ETHUSDT | 525,600 | 0 | 348,450 | 177,120 |
